text:
maria: Heads up — since ~06:10 UTC we're seeing remote_write backpressure from the us-west-gpu scrape pool. p95 scrape latency spiked, queue length > 6000, and some tenants hit 504s. Anyone seen this?

ashok: seeing same in graphs. looks correlated with GPU provisioning churn from a scale event. :eyes:

maria: grafana link: https://grafana/redwood/d/xyz/scrapes?orgId=1&var-cluster=us-west-gpu

lucy: logs show repeated "kv cache replay" backpressure messages and many relabel loops for exporter label "gpu_serial". snippet:

```
2026-03-20T06:11:02Z exporter: warn: relabel: duplicated metric series for gpu_serial=abc123
remote_write: enqueue failed: buffer full
```

sre-oncall: temporarily increased prometheus-proxy remote_write queue_capacity from 2500 -> 5000 for us-west to reduce drops. monitoring impact now.

dan: can we drop gpu_serial on scrape relabel for most exporters? it's high-cardinality and not needed for most dashboards.

maria: +1 — suggest relabel_config to drop for exporters/* and canary it.

ashok: quick relabel patch (canary):

```
relabel_configs:
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: gpu_serial
```

lucy: prefer labeldrop for exporter classes. also lowered scrape_timeout from 20s -> 10s for noisy exporters to reduce stalling. will watch for increased scrape failures.

deploy-bot: rolling config change started on prometheus-proxy-uswest (canary 2/3). :rocket:

maria: also added a temporary queue_capacity bump and a short-term backoff multiplier change on the proxy so pending batches drain faster.

ashok: long term: need scrape-window coalescing tweaks and per-tenant backpressure throttling. filed RW-721 to track.

lucy: found a tenant producing ~12k unique gpu_serials from a misbehaving sidecar — pinged that team @infra-team.

dan: will add alert: prometheus_proxy_queue_length > 4000 -> page (with 15m suppression to avoid thrash).

maria: leaving this thread open for postmortem notes. current p95 queue_length trending down after queue bump. will update in 15m.

sre-oncall: update 06:30 UTC — queue back to normal (200-400). proxies accepted pending batches. keeping relabel canary in place for 1h.

maria: follow-up: captured buffered payload sample and uploaded to S3 for debugging: s3://redwood-debug/uswest/3111112222/kv-sample-1.json

ashok: adding details to RW-721, assigning to dan. plan: controlled relabel rollout + automation to detect sudden label-card spikes and auto-suppress high-card labels.

ops-bot: incident closed — no longer paging. summary: https://go/redwood/incident/3111112222
